purpose: Reusable fixture contract for the two fail-closure classes of the C2 claim (H1 absent/unreadable scoped file, H3 blind-instrument floor). Calibrated against the frozen pre-edit v10 (sha 6f1d19ff...) and the landed r9 v11 (sha c95a5cf3..., per-readable-file floor).
floor_semantics: The landed r9 floor is PER READABLE FILE: every scoped file the run could read must contribute >= 1 current-ok locus (unit). Per-file loud controls were placed in all three crafted files so legitimate fixture trees satisfy it; floor probes are built by collapsing exactly one file.

after_history.82fb807e: r9-v1, global floor current-ok > 0 (measured with fixture layout v1 — superseded)
after_history.c95a5cf3: r9-v2, per-file floor counted in blocks (claim-breaking on HEAD per PL-2 §0; not re-measured by this seat)
after_history.df9ffdf9: r9-v3, per-file floor counted in detections (measured, snapshot kept)
after_history.a4c16763: r9-v4, header/Usage self-description fix (measured, snapshot kept)
after_history.d0772ce8: r9-v5, docstring/naming text only, behaviour identical to r9-v3/r9-v4 (measured, snapshot kept)

cases.note: Ordinary run on the repo's own three scoped files: the claim's invariance clause (PASS 0/0/0/0 before and after).
Hermetic positive control: exactly one current-ok locus per file (PROVINCE.md:20, SCORECARD.md:58, SKILL.md:19; omp=9.9.9 + receipt language). The per-file floor must not fire: PASS both phases.

H3 data-side reproduction: all scoped files present and >= their declared max end, every DATED marker in place, zero gate-token matches anywhere -> zero loci everywhere. Round-1 CR-5 produced this class by neutering the instrument's needles; this fixture produces it with legitimate input.

The exact per-file-collapse case the landed header names: SKILL.md readable but needle-free (zero loci) while PROVINCE.md and SCORECARD.md stay loud. A GLOBAL floor would PASS this tree; the landed per-readable-file floor FAILs it. Also the cleanest discriminator between the r9 revisions.

Reading probe: SCORECARD.md carries one historical locus (rea-agents@6.4.0 inside a DATED band) and no current-ok; PROVINCE.md and SKILL.md carry their loud controls. PER-FILE floor FAILs (SCORECARD.md=0); a GLOBAL floor PASSes (2 current-ok loci exist). Pins which reading is in force and whether one historical-only file may carry a file's floor contribution.

H1 core: the only omission is SKILL.md, whose declared rows are all CURRENT, so pre-fix nothing fires and the run reads PASS (the silent-PASS injection). Survivors stay loud, so the post-fix failure is the H1 class alone (declared list exactly ['UNREADABLE']).
Shape variant: a directory where SKILL.md is declared (OSError on open).
Shape variant: dangling symlink at the declared path.
Shape variant: file present, content intact, unreadable (EACCES). Requires a non-root uid (measured uid=1000).
H1 on a DATED-bearing file: pre-fix already FAILs via marker-uncheckable SCOPE-ERRORs; post-fix the failure is the declared UNREADABLE class (both indicators present).
Same as miss-province for the third scoped file.
Empty root: every scoped file unevaluable. Pre-fix FAIL (markers), post-fix FAIL with all three files named in the declared class; the per-file floor is vacuous (no readable file).

Round-1 residual H1b: a present-but-zero-byte CURRENT-only file. Pre-fix PASS (silent). The landed G19 truncation rule (len(lines) < declared max end) is expected to close it: FAIL + UNREADABLE. Advisory so a differently-worded implementation is reported, not failed.

H2 probe (named as NOT closed in the landed header): a fabricated non-live pin rea-agents@9.9.8 excused by the same-line token 'superseded' reads historical; the file keeps its separate genuine current-ok locus (SCORECARD.md:58), so the floor stays satisfied. Expectation is PASS both phases; a FAIL/current-ok reading for the 9.9.8 pin would mean H2 got closed.

Floor-granularity probe: two adjacent content lines fold into ONE block whose asserts mix current-ok + historical -> block disposition info. Measured history: r9-v1 (82fb807e, block-level global) FAIL BLIND-INSTRUMENT with current-ok loci=0/total=1; r9-v2 (c95a5cf3, per-file but block-counted) FAIL with SCORECARD.md=0; r9-v3 (df9ffdf9, per-file per-DETECTION) PASS with SCORECARD.md=1 -- the same class the landed header records at HEAD (SKILL.md's only locus-bearing block is mixed). Modes: ASSERT-COUNT = det-counted floor (PASS), UNIT-COUNT = block-counted floor (FAIL), VACUOUS-PASS = pre-r9 instrument (PASS via g2's old second disjunct).

H5 probe (unit boundary, not closed by design): 'The build shipped 6.7.0 last week.' carries no REA_GATE token, so it is not a locus in this unit. PASS both phases; also a non-vacuity check that the floor does not fire when each file's genuine current-ok locus exists.
